items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my grandmother named Mattie, she was like a teacher.

ctx.x: What did your grandparents do? What were their occupations?
My grandfather on my mother’s side was a minister in the AME church, and my grandmother named Mattie, she was like a teacher. So I heard, she was the first black woman to get a degree in Iowa.
